text:
maya: tiny note from the overlay spike: observed a 30-40ms median extra latency when applying overlay on canary nodes due to checksum+validation step. suggestion: use async validation where we allow overlay to be visible only after checksum done but rely on short-circuit checksums for small overlays (crc32) to fast-accept then background verify with sha256.

joel: risky from security POV. maybe accept crc32 for initial gating but keep sha256 required before we prepopulate kvcache. otherwise we might serve incorrect params briefly.

sam: could we use staged visibility: make overlay mmap readable but mark non-warm until full sha verification. inference can read overlay but fallback to base for critical paths until verified? complicated.

rachel: metrics again: overlay_verify_lag, overlay_served_unverified_count, overlay_rollback_postverify_count. need alerting rule if overlay_served_unverified_count > 0 for > 1m in prod.

linh: also observed slab fragmentation when many small overlays applied/evicted. patch-on-heap seems safer for tiny overlays. we should tune threshold.

maya: notes saved into the spike README. next: finalize heuristics and draft RFC.
